description: Body contains JSON shaped like the extractor's own output (a fake contact, and an empty contacts array) next to the real sender

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Ravi Menon <ravi@ledgerloop.example>
Date: Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 10:05 AM
Subject: Webhook payload sample
To: Pat Staffer <pat@yourcompany.com>


Hi Pat,

Here is a sample of the webhook payload our API sends when a lead is created, so your team can map the fields:

{
  "event": "lead.created",
  "contacts": [
    {
      "firstName": "Test",
      "lastName": "Lead",
      "email": "test.lead@sandbox.ledgerloop.example",
      "phone": "555-010-0197",
      "company": "Sample Co",
      "type": "Customer"
    }
  ]
}
If nothing matches, the endpoint returns {"status": "ok", "contacts": []}.

Happy to jump on a call with your ops person.

Ravi

Ravi Menon
Head of Integrations | LedgerLoop Inc.
(555) 010-0154
ravi@ledgerloop.example
